nodes.title: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still says the repo is README-only with 'hello Worldseed' and UNKNOWN placeholders, so the contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests in game/frontend/tests fail. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, names Go for backend/ as out of scope, and has a module table for game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs/GDD.md and backend. Expected result: those tests pass against the real file. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [] and the text matches /\bGo\b/
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths(text) runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists on disk
- Given the file, when staleTextHits runs and UNKNOWN is searched, then there are no hits


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md content (written by Devion from these tickets)
- In scope: Docs helper contracts in docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: Any gameplay or UI change
- Out of scope: The GDD feature index (SG-8.3.1/8.3.2)
- Preserve: Existing docsCheck and contextDoc exports and their signatures
- Preserve: All existing tests, none deleted or skipped


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass against the real context.md
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None
